description: This file defines the EmployeeSalaryDao class responsible for data access related to EmployeeSalary entities in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving, deleting, fetching, and counting employee salary records, typically interacting with a database through Doctrine ORM query builders.

classes.name: EmployeeSalaryDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for EmployeeSalary entity, providing CRUD operations and query methods for employee salary information.

methods.name: saveEmployeeSalary
methods.description: Persists an EmployeeSalary entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeDirectDebit
methods.description: Removes an EmpDirectDebit entity from the database.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeSalaries
methods.description: Deletes multiple EmployeeSalary records for a given employee based on a list of salary IDs.

methods.name: getEmployeeSalary
methods.description: Fetches a specific EmployeeSalary record for a given employee number and salary ID.

methods.name: getExistingEmployeeSalaryIdsByEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves existing EmployeeSalary IDs for a given employee number from a list of IDs.

methods.name: getEmployeeSalaries
methods.description: Returns a list of EmployeeSalary records matching the provided search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeSalariesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of EmployeeSalary records matching the search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeSalariesPaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a Paginator object for EmployeeSalary records based on search filter parameters and sorting/pagination settings.
